theme: An open Saturday on the coast, nothing on the calendar.
greeting: The calendar's empty and the girls are with Jen, Dan, so it's a wide-open Saturday in Maine. Two things want a word: Eugenia is holding times for a PRI talk, and Mike's surgery prep has slipped a day.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: Eugenia Unanyants-Jackson offered Monday 12-2 PM ET or Thursday windows for a PRI talk; the slot is waiting on you, and Monday is two days out.

needsAttention.title: Mike's oral surgery prep
needsAttention.detail: Prep for the Aug 20 oral surgery in Portland is a day past due. Next up: confirm pre-op instructions by Aug 17 and a driver by Aug 18.

flagged.title: PRI - Eugenia awaiting your reply
flagged.detail: She offered Monday 12-2 PM ET or Thursday to talk through the PRI situation.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley holdings notice
flagged.detail: Proxy / important information on your private markets and alternatives holdings.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and retail promos - NYT Cooking, FT, New Yorker, Mandarin Oriental, and a stack of shop sales.

recipe.title: Tomatoes all dressed up for summer
recipe.why: Peak August tomatoes and a slow Saturday in Maine — dress them simply and let them be most of dinner.

acts.line: Back in Maine — an open, unhurried morning.
Nothing on the calendar; the day is yours.
